name: 귀 일관성 분석
description: 비디오 프레임에서 귀 모양, 위치 및 대칭의 시간적 불일치를 감지합니다.
useCase: Identifying 딥페이크s 분석하여 ear morphology stability over time
mechanism: Tracks ear landmarks 에 걸친 frames and 측정 geometric consistency. Ears are highly individual 특징 that 딥페이크 models frequently fail to reproduce consistently, showing warping, asymmetry changes, or disappearing details 사이의 frames.
source: Nguyen, H. et al. (2019) - Multi-task Learning For Detecting and Segmenting Manipulated Facial Images and Videos, BTAS
algorithm: Ear Landmark Detection + Geometric Consistency Tracking + Temporal Stability Scoring
parameters: Landmarks: 55-point ear model, Tracking window: 10 frames, Metrics: shape stability, symmetry ratio
